WITH customer_payments AS (

         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders,
         AVG(op.order_total) AS avg_payment
  FROM orders o
  JOIN (

),
top_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, num_orders, avg_payment

),

SELECT p.name_given, b.g, b.r, b.h, b.hr
FROM batting b
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = b.player_id
WHERE b.g = (SELECT MAX(g) FROM batting)
   OR b.r = (SELECT MAX(r) FROM batting)
   OR b.h = (SELECT MAX(h) FROM batting)
   OR b.hr = (SELECT MAX(hr) FROM batting);

      POWER(SIN(RADIANS((a.coordinates[1] - b.coordinates[1]) / 2)), 2) +
      COS(RADIANS(a.coordinates[1])) * COS(RADIANS(b.coordinates[1])) *
      POWER(SIN(RADIANS((a.coordinates[0] - b.coordinates[0]) / 2)), 2)

SELECT w1.name, w2.name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Cards c ON m.card_id = c.id
JOIN Belts b ON m.title_id = b.id
JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id
JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id
WHERE b.name LIKE '%NXT%'
  AND (m.title_change IS NULL OR m.title_change = 0)
  AND m.duration IS NOT NULL
  AND m.duration != ''
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, 1, INSTR(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
       + CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, INSTR(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT b.bowler, p.player_name, b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, SUM(b.runs) AS runs_conceded
FROM (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.over_id, bb.ball_id, bb.innings_no, bb.bowler,
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0) AS runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs
      ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er
      ON bb.match_id = er.match_id AND bb.over_id = er.over_id AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
) b
JOIN player p ON b.bowler = p.player_id
GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no
ORDER BY runs_conceded DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.striker AS player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs
      ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id
     AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id
     AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
     AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
) t
JOIN player p ON p.player_id = t.player_id
JOIN match m ON m.match_id = t.match_id
JOIN ball_by_ball bb2
  ON bb2.match_id = t.match_id
 AND bb2.striker = t.player_id
WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND m.match_winner <> bb2.team_batting
GROUP BY p.player_name, t.match_id;

SELECT strftime('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2016' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_2016,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_2017,
       SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_2018
FROM olist_orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016','2017','2018')
GROUP BY strftime('%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT MAX(monthly_count) AS highest_monthly_delivered_volume
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS ym,
           COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016','2017','2018')
    GROUP BY ym
) t
WHERE strftime('%Y', ym || '-01') = (
    SELECT year
    FROM (
        SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
               COUNT(*) AS annual_count
        FROM olist_orders o
        WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
          AND strftime('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016','2017','2018')
        GROUP BY year
        ORDER BY annual_count ASC
        LIMIT 1
    )
);

WITH city_payments AS (
  SELECT c.customer_city AS city,
         o.order_id,
         p.payment_value
  FROM olist_orders o
  JOIN olist_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
city_totals AS (
  SELECT city, SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment
  FROM city_payments
  GROUP BY city
),
lowest_cities AS (
  SELECT city FROM city_totals ORDER BY total_payment ASC LIMIT 5
)
SELECT cp.city,
       AVG(cp.payment_value) AS avg_payment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cp.order_id) AS order_count
FROM city_payments cp
JOIN lowest_cities lc ON cp.city = lc.city
GROUP BY cp.city;

SELECT AVG(payment_count) AS avg_total_payment_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.product_category_name,
        oop.payment_type,
        COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.product_category_name
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM olist_order_payments oop
    JOIN olist_orders o ON oop.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name, oop.payment_type
)
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS full_name
FROM actor a
JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
JOIN language l ON l.language_id = f.language_id
WHERE l.name = 'English'
  AND f.rating IN ('G', 'PG')
  AND f.length <= 120
  AND CAST(f.release_year AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name
FROM category c
JOIN film_category fc ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
JOIN inventory i ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
JOIN city ci ON ci.city_id = a.city_id
WHERE ci.city LIKE 'A%' OR ci.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM((julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) * 24) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.FirstName, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS AmountSpent
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE al.ArtistId = (
    SELECT al2.ArtistId
    FROM invoice_items ii2
    JOIN tracks t2 ON ii2.TrackId = t2.TrackId
    JOIN albums al2 ON t2.AlbumId = al2.AlbumId
    GROUP BY al2.ArtistId
    ORDER BY SUM(ii2.UnitPrice * ii2.Quantity) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName
HAVING SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) < 1;

WITH profits AS (
  SELECT s.cust_id,
         SUM(s.amount_sold - s.quantity_sold * c.unit_cost) AS profit
  FROM sales s
  JOIN costs c ON s.prod_id = c.prod_id AND s.time_id = c.time_id AND s.channel_id = c.channel_id AND s.promo_id = c.promo_id
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'Italy'
    AND s.time_id >= '2021-12-01' AND s.time_id < '2022-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.cust_id
),
tiers AS (
  SELECT cust_id, profit,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY profit) AS tier
  FROM profits
)
SELECT tier, MIN(profit) AS lowest_profit, MAX(profit) AS highest_profit
FROM tiers
GROUP BY tier
ORDER BY tier;

WITH spend AS (
  SELECT o.customerid, SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_details od ON o.orderid = od.orderid
  WHERE strftime('%Y', o.orderdate) = '1998'
  GROUP BY o.customerid
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT s.customerid,
    (SELECT g.groupname FROM customergroupthreshold g
     WHERE s.total >= g.rangebottom AND s.total < g.rangetop
     LIMIT 1) AS groupname
  FROM spend s
)
SELECT groupname,
  COUNT(*) AS customercount,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers), 2) AS pctoftotal
FROM grouped
GROUP BY groupname
ORDER BY customercount DESC;

SELECT s.businessentityid,
       strftime('%Y', soh.orderdate) AS sales_year,
       SUM(soh.totaldue) AS total_sales,
       sq.salesquota AS quota,
       SUM(soh.totaldue) - sq.salesquota AS difference
FROM salesorderheader soh
JOIN salesperson s ON s.businessentityid = soh.salespersonid
JOIN SalesPersonQuotaHistory sq
  ON sq.BusinessEntityID = s.businessentityid
 AND strftime('%Y', sq.QuotaDate) = strftime('%Y', soh.orderdate)
GROUP BY s.businessentityid, strftime('%Y', soh.orderdate), sq.salesquota
ORDER BY s.businessentityid, sales_year;

SELECT n.id, n.name, COUNT(DISTINCT dm.movie_id) AS movie_count,
ROUND(AVG(m.duration), 0) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
ROUND(AVG(r.avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
SUM(r.total_votes) AS total_votes,
MIN(r.avg_rating) AS min_rating,
MAX(r.avg_rating) AS max_rating,
SUM(m.duration) AS total_movie_duration
FROM director_mapping dm
JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
LEFT JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
GROUP BY n.id, n.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS ratio
FROM orders o
WHERE o.store_id = (
    SELECT store_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY store_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT h.hub_id, h.hub_name
FROM hubs h
JOIN stores s ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
  AND o.order_created_year = 2021
  AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY h.hub_id, h.hub_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 1.2 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END);

  SELECT player_id,
         SUM(runs) AS total_runs,

),
balls_faced AS (
  SELECT bb.striker AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_balls

WITH stack_scores AS (
  SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_score
  FROM model_score
  WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack AS (
  SELECT ms.name, ms.version, ms.step, ms.model, ms.test_score,
         ss.stack_score
  FROM model_score ms
  JOIN stack_scores ss
    ON ms.name = ss.name AND ms.version = ss.version AND ms.step = ss.step
  WHERE ms.model <> 'Stack'
),
status_per_step AS (
  SELECT name, version, step,
         CASE
           WHEN MAX(test_score) < MAX(stack_score) THEN 'strong'
           WHEN MAX(test_score) = MAX(stack_score) THEN 'soft'
         END AS status
  FROM non_stack
  GROUP BY name, version, step
),
l1_per_step AS (
  SELECT m.name, m.version, m.step, m.L1_model, s.status
  FROM model m
  JOIN status_per_step s
    ON m.name = s.name AND m.version = s

SELECT p.name, AVG(CAST(pl.qty AS REAL) / o.qty * 100) AS avg_pick_pct
FROM picking_line pl
JOIN picking_list plist ON plist.id = pl.picklist_id
JOIN orderlines o ON o.order_id = pl.order_id AND o.product_id = pl.product_id
JOIN products p ON p.id = pl.product_id
JOIN inventory inv ON inv.location_id = pl.location_id AND inv.product_id = pl.product_id
JOIN purchases pu ON pu.id = inv.purchase_id
WHERE pl.qty = MIN(o.qty, inv.qty)
GROUP BY p.name;

SELECT p.name, AVG(pl.qty) AS avg_units_picked
FROM picking_line pl
JOIN products p ON p.id = pl.product_id
WHERE pl.order_id = 421
GROUP BY pl.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY p.name;

ORDER BY session, path, search_type;

JOIN results res ON res.race_id = r.race_id AND res.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE r.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = r.year)
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, r.year
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, dr.year
FROM drives dr
JOIN drivers d ON d.driver_id = dr.driver_id
WHERE dr.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  AND dr.is_first_drive_of_season = 1
  AND dr.is_final_drive_of_season = 1
  AND dr.constructor_id = (
      SELECT dr2.constructor_id
      FROM drives dr2
      WHERE dr2.year = dr.year
        AND dr2.driver_id = dr.driver_id
        AND dr2.is_final_drive_of_season = 1
  )
  AND (
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.round)
      FROM results res
      JOIN races r ON r.race_id = res.race_id
      WHERE res.driver_id = dr.driver_id
        AND r.year = dr.year
  ) >= 2
GROUP BY d.driver_id, dr.year
ORDER BY dr.year, d.surname;

SELECT d.year,
       AVG(d.first_round) AS avg_first_round,
       AVG(d.last_round) AS avg_last_round
FROM (
    SELECT r.year,
           res.driver_id,
           MIN(r.round) AS first_round,
           MAX(r.round) AS last_round,
           COUNT(*) AS missed_races,
           COUNT(DISTINCT res.constructor_id) AS team_count
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE res.position IS NULL
    GROUP BY r.year, res.driver_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
       AND COUNT(DISTINCT res.constructor_id) > 1
) d
GROUP BY d.year
ORDER BY d.year;
